module: Mechanics controller (type "auxiliary") that links two beams in series: at each physics step, if the sum of their lengths exceeds their initial combined length, the excess is removed equally from both (obj:setBeamLength). Useful to simulate a chain or a cable with two sections. If one of the beams breaks, the other is broken too and the system disables itself.
notes: jbeam key: beamTag (required), beam tag that must match exactly 2 beams (beamstate.tagBeamMap); otherwise an error is logged and the controller stays inactive (update and updateGFX stay nil).
The beamBroken(id, energy) hook is called by the engine when a beam breaks.

update.desc: Defined at init if the configuration is valid.

updateGFX.desc: Defined (empty) at init if the configuration is valid.

init.desc: Finds the two beams of the tag and stores their combined length.

update.desc: Every physics step: removes the excess length equally from the two beams.

beamBroken.desc: Hook: called when a beam breaks; if it is one of the two, breaks the other and disables the chain.
